text: The bank said my account was operationally unserviceable, which is the nicest thing anyone's said to me all week, and I was in for forty dollars.
name: Ray Okafor

text: The rent went up eleven percent and the building put up a sign about passion, and I thought, right, that's where my eleven percent went.
name: Sofia Marchetti

text: The gas station changed its price on a Tuesday, and my whole paycheck rearranged itself to make it fit, which I didn't think it was allowed to do.
name: Latasha Boone
